title: SYNTHETIC BIOLOGY PROMOTION ACT

SYNTHETIC BIOLOGY PROMOTION ACT

CHAPTER I GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Act is to contribute to the continued development of the national economy and the improvement of the quality of life of the people by laying the foundations for research and development in synthetic biology, ensuring stability, and promoting innovation in science and technology through the use of synthetic biology.

Article 2 (Definitions)
The terms used in this Act are defined as follows: <Amended on October 1, 2025>
1. The term "synthetic biology" means a field of study and technology within biotechnology that involves designing, constructing, and utilizing the components and systems of living organisms through engineering methods;
2. The term "biofoundry" means a facility supporting biological research in which the series of processes for design, construction, testing, and learning in synthetic biology is standardized, accelerated, and automated;
3. The term "synthetic biology research entities" means research institutions, their affiliated researchers, and relevant experts that carry out national research and development projects related to synthetic biology (referring to national research and development projects under subparagraph 1 of Article 2 of the National Research and Development Innovation Act; hereinafter the same shall apply) and research and development in the private sector;
4. The term "synthetic biology research data" means materials or information capable of being processed by optical (光) or electronic means, which synthetic biology research entities manage after generating or acquiring them in the course of, or as a result of, experiments, surveys, or collection activities for synthetic biology research;
5. The term "relevant central administrative agencies" means central administrative agencies related to the promotion of synthetic biology, such as the Ministry of Finance and Economy, the Ministry of Science and ICT, the Ministry of Education, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, the Ministry of Trade and Industry, the Ministry of Health and Welfare, the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment, the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, the Ministry of SMEs and Startups, the Ministry of Planning and Budget, the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, the Ministry of Intellectual Property, the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency, the Rural Development Administration, and the Korea Forest Service.

Article 3 (Responsibilities of the State, etc.)
(1) The State shall formulate comprehensive policies for the promotion of synthetic biology and develop measures for the administrative, technical, and financial support necessary for those policies.
(2) Synthetic biology research entities shall actively cooperate in implementing the policies formulated by the State pursuant to paragraph (1).

Article 4 (Relationship to Other Acts)
Except as otherwise specifically provided in other Acts, the promotion of synthetic biology shall be governed by this Act.

CHAPTER II SYSTEM FOR THE PROMOTION AND ADVANCEMENT OF SYNTHETIC BIOLOGY

Article 5 (Formulation of Basic Plans for the Promotion of Synthetic Biology)
(1) The Government shall formulate a basic plan for the promotion of synthetic biology (hereinafter referred to as a "basic plan") every five years.
(2) A basic plan shall include the following matters:
1. Matters concerning medium- and long-term policy objectives and directions for the promotion of synthetic biology;
2. Matters concerning trends, the current status, and the direction of development of synthetic biology;
3. Matters concerning plans to expand investment and secure financial resources for the promotion of synthetic biology;
4. Matters concerning research and development, including basic research, research on foundational technologies, research on industrial applications, and convergence research in synthetic biology;
5. Matters concerning the promotion of technology transfer, commercialization, and business startups related to synthetic biology;
6. Matters concerning the establishment and use of synthetic biology research facilities and of public biofoundries under Article 19;
7. Matters concerning the protection and utilization of intellectual property rights in the outcomes of synthetic biology;
8. Matters concerning the development and support of infrastructure for synthetic biology, including personnel, information, statistics, and standards;
9. Matters concerning cooperation among industry, academia, and the research community in relation to synthetic biology;
10. Matters concerning the promotion of international cooperation related to synthetic biology;
11. Matters concerning the establishment and improvement of institutional arrangements to promote the development and commercialization of synthetic biology technologies;
12. Matters concerning ensuring the safety of synthetic biology;
13. Other important matters concerning the promotion of the development and industrialization of synthetic biology technologies.
(3) The Minister of Science and ICT shall formulate a basic plan in consultation with the heads of relevant central administrative agencies and finalize it following deliberation by the Comprehensive Biotechnology Policy Deliberation Council under Article 7 of the Biotechnology Support Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Council"). The same shall apply to amendments to a basic plan (excluding amendments to minor matters prescribed by Presidential Decree).
(4) Where the Minister of Science and ICT considers it necessary for duties such as formulating and implementing a basic plan or an implementation plan under Article 6, the Minister may request relevant central administrative agencies or institutions or organizations related to synthetic biology research and development to provide necessary materials.
(5) An agency, institution, or organization requested to provide materials under paragraph (4) shall comply with the request unless there are special grounds not to do so.
(6) A basic plan shall be in harmony with the basic plan for science and technology under Article 7 of the Framework Act on Science and Technology and the basic plan for the promotion of biotechnology under Article 5 of the Biotechnology Support Act.
(7) Matters necessary for the formulation of basic plans and related affairs, other than those prescribed in paragraphs (1) through (5), shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 6 (Formulation and Implementation of Annual Implementation Plans, etc.)
(1) The Minister of Science and ICT shall, in consultation with the heads of relevant central administrative agencies, formulate and implement an annual implementation plan (hereinafter referred to as an "implementation plan") in accordance with the basic plan.
(2) The Minister of Science and ICT shall report to the Council on the results of implementing the implementation plan for the preceding year and on the implementation plan for the following year.
(3) Matters necessary for the formulation and implementation of implementation plans and for reporting under paragraph (2) shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 7 (Working Committee for the Promotion of Synthetic Biology)
(1) A Working Committee for the Promotion of Synthetic Biology may be established within the Council to review in advance agenda items in the field of synthetic biology to be submitted to the Council and to handle duties delegated by the Council and other related matters.
(2) The composition and operation of the Working Committee for the Promotion of Synthetic Biology under paragraph (1), and other necessary matters, shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 8 (Recommendations, etc. for Improving Statutes, Regulations, and Institutional Arrangements Related to the Promotion of Synthetic Biology)
Where the head of a relevant central administrative agency considers reasonable improvements to statutes, regulations, and institutional arrangements necessary in connection with the promotion of synthetic biology, that head may express opinions or make recommendations to the head of the central administrative agency responsible for the relevant statutes and regulations.

Article 9 (Surveys of Current Conditions and Outlooks and Forecasts for Development)
(1) The Minister of Science and ICT shall annually survey technological, industrial, policy, and institutional conditions relating to synthetic biology in Korea and abroad, assess the outlook for and forecast the direction of its development, and reflect the results in the formulation of the basic plan and implementation plan.
(2) Matters necessary for surveys of current conditions and outlooks and forecasts for development under paragraph (1) shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 10 (Compilation of Statistics)
(1) The Minister of Science and ICT shall compile and manage relevant statistics to efficiently formulate policies for the promotion of synthetic biology.
(2) Where necessary for the compilation of statistics under paragraph (1) and other related purposes, the Minister of Science and ICT may request relevant materials from the heads of other relevant central administrative agencies, the heads of local governments, the heads of enterprises, universities, research institutions, and medical institutions, and the heads of other public institutions and organizations. In such cases, a person requested to submit materials shall cooperate unless there are special grounds for not doing so.
(3) When compiling statistics under paragraph (1), care shall be taken to ensure that they do not duplicate the biotechnology statistics under Article 21 of the Biotechnology Support Act.
(4) Matters necessary for the subjects covered by and methods used in the compilation of statistics under paragraphs (1) and (2) shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 11 (Technology Impact Assessments and Technology Level Assessments)
(1) The Minister of Science and ICT shall assess in advance the effects of synthetic biology technologies on the economy, society, culture, ethics, the environment, and other areas, and the heads of relevant central administrative agencies shall reflect the results in their policies.
(2) The Minister of Science and ICT shall assess technological levels in synthetic biology in Korea and abroad, and the heads of relevant central administrative agencies shall formulate and implement measures to improve those technological levels.
(3) Matters necessary for the procedures, methods, and other aspects of technology impact assessments under paragraph (1) and technology level assessments under paragraph (2) shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree, applying Article 14 of the Framework Act on Science and Technology mutatis mutandis.

Article 12 (Synthetic Biology Development Council)
(1) The Minister of Science and ICT may establish the Synthetic Biology Development Council (hereinafter referred to as the “Development Council”) to promote information exchanges, personnel exchanges, joint research, and other cooperation among the industrial, academic, and research sectors in the field of synthetic biology. In such cases, the Government may provide support for expenses necessary for the operation of the Development Council.
(2) The composition and operation of the Development Council and other necessary matters shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 13 (Designation of Institutions Specializing in Synthetic Biology Policy)
(1) The Minister of Science and ICT may designate institutions specializing in synthetic biology policy to efficiently support the formulation and coordination of policies for the promotion of synthetic biology and the development and utilization of related technologies.
(2) The Minister of Science and ICT may, within budgetary limits, provide financial support for all or part of the costs necessary for the operation and other activities of an institution specializing in synthetic biology policy designated under paragraph (1) (hereinafter referred to as a “Policy Center”).
(3) Where a Policy Center falls under any of the following subparagraphs, the Minister of Science and ICT may revoke its designation:
1. Where it no longer meets the requirements for designation prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Science and ICT;
2. Where it can no longer achieve the purpose for which it was designated as a Policy Center.
(4) Matters necessary for the duties of Policy Centers, the requirements and procedures for their designation, and other related matters shall be determined by the Minister of Science and ICT.

CHAPTER III PROMOTION AND SUPPORT OF SYNTHETIC BIOLOGY RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT

Article 14 (Implementation of Research and Development Programs)
(1) The heads of relevant central administrative agencies may implement national research and development programs related to synthetic biology to efficiently implement the basic plan and implementation plan.
(2) The selection of research and development projects and research and development institutions for carrying out national research and development programs related to synthetic biology, and the procedures for concluding agreements with the selected research and development institutions, shall be governed by the National Research and Development Innovation Act.
(3) For purposes such as formulating strategies for technology development in synthetic biology and determining directions for research and development investment, the Minister of Science and ICT shall prepare a comprehensive technology roadmap for synthetic biology, as prescribed by Presidential Decree, after hearing the opinions of the heads of relevant central administrative agencies.
(4) When implementing national research and development programs related to synthetic biology, the heads of relevant central administrative agencies shall actively reflect the technology roadmap prepared under paragraph (3) in identifying core technologies to be developed and in other related activities.

Article 15 (Designation of Hub Institutions for Synthetic Biology Research and Development, Etc.)
(1) The Minister of Science and ICT may designate hub institutions for synthetic biology research and development to promote innovation in and the dissemination of synthetic biology research and development and to establish, maintain, and develop an integrated system of cooperation among the industrial, academic, and research sectors.
(2) A hub institution for synthetic biology research and development designated under paragraph (1) (hereinafter referred to as a “hub institution”) shall perform the following functions:
1. Mission-oriented research and development programs under Article 11(1) of the Special Act on Fostering National Strategic Technologies, challenging research and development under Article 15-2 of the Framework Act on Science and Technology, and development of core equipment and components, relating to the field of synthetic biology;
2. Development of foundational synthetic biology technologies through coordination and cooperation among hub institutions;
3. Technology transfer and commercialization of research and development outcomes of hub institutions, and support for business start-ups;
4. Installation and operation of shared research and development facilities and demonstration facilities for synthetic biology;
5. Technical support for small and medium enterprises under Article 2 of the Framework Act on Small and Medium Enterprises and venture businesses under Article 2(1) of the Special Act on the Promotion of Venture Businesses that are related to synthetic biology;
6. Promotion of joint and convergence research among the industrial, academic, and research sectors;
7. Dissemination of technologies and knowledge for building and operating infrastructure;
8. Other matters deemed necessary by the Minister of Science and ICT.
(3) The Government may provide support for all or part of the expenses necessary for the operation of hub institutions.
(4) Where a hub institution falls under any of the following subparagraphs, the Minister of Science and ICT may revoke its designation:
1. Where it no longer meets the requirements for designation;
2. Where there are substantial grounds to believe that the purpose of designation as a hub institution would be difficult to achieve.
(5) Matters necessary for the requirements, methods, and procedures for designation of hub institutions, and other related matters, shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 16 (Support for Innovative Development)
In connection with the promotion of synthetic biology, the Government may implement support policies for technological innovation, capacity building, and shared growth of domestic enterprises, universities under subparagraph 2 of Article 2 of the Special Act on Support of Science and Engineering Manpower for Strengthening National Science and Technology Competitiveness, and institutions or organizations related to industry or technology.

Article 17 (Promotion of Technology Transfer and Commercialization)
The Government may provide necessary administrative, technical, and financial support to disseminate the outcomes of national research and development programs related to synthetic biology and promote the transfer and commercialization of synthetic biology technologies held by enterprises, universities, and research institutions.

CHAPTER IV ESTABLISHMENT OF SYNTHETIC BIOLOGY RESEARCH INFRASTRUCTURE AND CREATION OF A SUPPORTIVE ENVIRONMENT

Article 18 (Support for Synthetic Biology Research Facilities and Equipment, etc.)

The Government may formulate and implement support measures concerning the securing, management, and joint use of research facilities and equipment and other related matters to expand the research infrastructure for synthetic biology.

Article 19 (Establishment and Operation of Public Biofoundries)

(1) The Government may establish and operate biofoundries for research and development in synthetic biology and for its application.

(2) The Government may designate operating institutions for the efficient management and use of biofoundries established and operated under paragraph (1) (hereinafter referred to as “public biofoundries”).

(3) The Government shall endeavor to enable the domestic and foreign industrial, academic, and research sectors to jointly use public biofoundries to ensure their efficient use. In such cases, it may require users or user institutions to bear all or part of the costs of their use.

(4) The Government shall secure the budget necessary to obtain facilities and equipment in line with changes in demand in the industrial, academic, and research sectors and the pace of technological development, to ensure the efficient operation and use of public biofoundries.

(5) Costs necessary for the establishment, operation, and joint use of public biofoundries may be covered by government contributions, amounts borne by users or user institutions under paragraph (3), or other funds.

(6) Matters necessary for the establishment, operation, use, and management of public biofoundries, the requirements and procedures for designation of operating institutions under paragraph (2), and other related matters shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 20 (Promotion of the Use of Synthetic Biology Research Data)

(1) Synthetic biology research data generated or acquired by a synthetic biology research entity through the use of a public biofoundry may be jointly used by that research entity and the operating institution of the public biofoundry designated under Article 19 (2) (hereinafter referred to as “operating institution” in this Article).

(2) Where an operating institution intends to support the research and development of another synthetic biology research entity by using synthetic biology research data that may be jointly used under paragraph (1), it shall obtain the consent of the research entity that generated or acquired the data.

(3) Other matters necessary for the use of synthetic biology research data shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 21 (Formulation of Measures for the Use of Synthetic Biology Research Data, etc.)

(1) The Government may formulate and implement measures necessary for the use of synthetic biology research data.

(2) The Government may undertake support projects to promote the generation and collection, processing and analysis, and sharing and use of synthetic biology research data.

(3) The Government may make contributions or provide support to cover all or part of the costs of participants from the industrial, academic, and research sectors in support projects under paragraph (2).

Article 22 (Standardization in Synthetic Biology)

The Government may formulate and implement the following measures concerning standardization in synthetic biology for research and development related to synthetic biology, dissemination of results, ensuring interoperability, and other related purposes:

1. Research and development related to synthetic biology standardization, and dissemination and diffusion of research results;
2. Surveys and research on domestic and international trends related to synthetic biology standardization;
3. International cooperation on synthetic biology standardization;
4. Other matters necessary for synthetic biology standardization.

Article 23 (Training and Securing Specialized Personnel)

(1) To train specialized personnel in synthetic biology, the Government shall devise measures for establishing specialized education and training programs, providing overseas training for specialized personnel, attracting and making use of outstanding personnel from abroad, and other related matters.

(2) To train specialized personnel in synthetic biology, the Government may undertake the following projects in cooperation with the industrial, academic, and research sectors:

1. Personnel training projects through educational institutions, including high schools prescribed by Presidential Decree from among the high schools under Article 2, subparagraph 3, of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act;
2. Personnel training projects through universities under Article 2, subparagraph 2, of the Special Act on Support of Science and Engineering Manpower for Strengthening National Science and Technology Competitiveness;
3. Personnel training projects through government-funded research institutions in science and technology under the Act on the Establishment, Operation and Fostering of Government-Funded Research Institutions in Science and Technology, Etc.;
4. Personnel training projects related to synthetic biology research facilities and equipment, including biofoundries, and increasing the number of specialized teaching staff in related fields;
5. Other projects necessary to train specialized personnel in synthetic biology.

Article 24 (Promotion of International Cooperation)

The Government shall keep abreast of international trends in synthetic biology, endeavor to promote international exchanges and international cooperation, and devise efficient measures for introducing advanced technologies.

CHAPTER V RESPONSIBLE MANAGEMENT OF SYNTHETIC BIOLOGY

Article 25 (Guidelines for Research and Development in Synthetic Biology)
(1) The Minister of Science and ICT may establish guidelines for research and development in synthetic biology (hereinafter referred to as "research and development guidelines") to clarify procedures and methods for research and development, including experimental research in synthetic biology, thereby preventing biological hazards, adverse environmental effects, and ethical problems in advance and creating an autonomous and safe research environment.
(2) When preparing research and development guidelines, the Minister of Science and ICT shall first gather opinions from experts in industry, academia, and research and other relevant persons, and consult with the heads of the relevant central administrative agencies.
(3) The Minister of Science and ICT may provide education to synthetic biology research entities so that research and development guidelines may be widely disseminated and used in industry, academia, and research.
(4) Matters necessary for the content and preparation of research and development guidelines shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 26 (Establishment and Operation of Safety Management Systems)
(1) The Minister of Science and ICT may, in consultation with the heads of the relevant central administrative agencies, establish and operate a safety management system to address risks and environmental effects that may arise in the course of national research and development projects related to synthetic biology, the use of their outcomes, and other related activities. In such cases, the safety management system shall incorporate the content of the research and development guidelines.
(2) The heads of the relevant central administrative agencies may conduct safety management monitoring of exposure to hazardous substances, environmental effects, and other matters that may arise in national research and development projects related to synthetic biology. In such cases, the heads of the relevant central administrative agencies shall notify the Minister of Science and ICT of the results of safety management monitoring.
(3) Where the heads of the relevant central administrative agencies intend to conduct safety management monitoring under paragraph (2), they shall announce in advance the timing and methods of safety management monitoring when inviting applications for the relevant national research and development project.
(4) Where necessary when conducting safety management monitoring under paragraph (2), the heads of the relevant central administrative agencies may request materials from the heads of other relevant central administrative agencies or the heads of research and development institutions or organizations. In such cases, a person requested to submit materials shall cooperate unless there is a special reason not to do so.
(5) Based on the results of safety management monitoring under paragraph (2), the heads of the relevant central administrative agencies may request the heads of other relevant central administrative agencies or the heads of research and development institutions or organizations to take appropriate measures.
(6) Where the heads of other relevant central administrative agencies or the heads of research and development institutions or organizations take appropriate measures under paragraph (5), they shall notify the Minister of Science and ICT of the results.
(7) Matters concerning the establishment and operation of a safety management system under paragraph (1) and the methods and procedures for safety management monitoring under paragraph (2) shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 27 (Gathering Opinions of Interested Parties)
When formulating a basic plan or policies for the promotion of synthetic biology, the heads of the relevant central administrative agencies shall hear the opinions of experts and interested parties and, where necessary, hold public hearings and reflect the opinions presented therein.

Article 28 (Enhancing Public Understanding)
The heads of the relevant central administrative agencies may undertake necessary projects, such as identifying and publicizing successful cases in synthetic biology and conducting experiential, educational, and competition programs for students and other persons, to enhance public understanding of the importance of synthetic biology and broaden public consensus.

CHAPTER VI SUPPLEMENTARY PROVISIONS

Article 29 (Delegation of Authority and Entrustment of Duties)
(1) Part of the authority of the heads of the relevant central administrative agencies under this Act may be delegated to the heads of their affiliated agencies, as prescribed by Presidential Decree.
(2) Part of the duties of the heads of the relevant central administrative agencies under this Act may be entrusted to relevant institutions or organizations with specialized capabilities and personnel, as prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 30 (Deemed Public Officials for Purposes of Penalty Provisions)
Officers and employees of Policy Centers designated under Article 13 (1), public biofoundry operating institutions designated under Article 19 (2), and institutions or organizations engaged in duties entrusted by the heads of the relevant central administrative agencies under Article 29 shall be deemed public officials for purposes of applying Articles 127 and 129 through 132 of the Criminal Act.

ADDENDA <Act No. 20923, April 22, 2025>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Act shall enter into force one year after the date of its promulgation.

Article 2 (Amendment of Another Act)
The Biotechnology Support Act is partially amended as follows:
Subparagraph 9-2 shall be newly inserted in Article 7 (2) as follows:
9-2. Important policies in the field of synthetic biology, including the basic plan for the promotion of synthetic biology and annual implementation plans under the Synthetic Biology Promotion Act.

ADDENDA (Government Organization Act) <Act No. 21065, October 1, 2025>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That those portions amending Acts under Article 7 of these Addenda that were promulgated before this Act enters into force but whose enforcement dates have not yet arrived shall enter into force on the respective enforcement dates of those Acts, and the following amended provisions shall enter into force on the dates specified in the respective subparagraphs:
1. The amended provisions in the following items shall enter into force on January 2, 2026: Provided, That those portions amending Acts under Article 7 of these Addenda (limited to portions related to the amended provisions in items (a) and (b)) that were promulgated before the enforcement date prescribed in the main clause but whose enforcement dates have not yet arrived as of the enforcement date prescribed in the main clause shall enter into force on the respective enforcement dates of those Acts:
(a) The amended provisions of Articles 19 (4), 23, 29 (1) 1, and 30;
(b) The amended provisions of Articles 12 (2), 19 (3), and 22 and the proviso to Article 29 (2) (limited to portions concerning the Minister of Finance and Economy and the Ministry of Finance and Economy);
(c) Acts amended under Article 7 of these Addenda (limited to portions related to the amended provisions in items (a) and (b)).
2. Omitted.

Articles 2 through 6 Omitted.

Article 7 (Amendments of Other Acts)
(1) through (102) Omitted.
(103) The Synthetic Biology Promotion Act is partially amended as follows:
In subparagraph 5 of Article 2, "Ministry of Economy and Finance, Ministry of Education, Ministry of Science and ICT, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, Ministry of Health and Welfare, Ministry of Environment, Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, Ministry of SMEs and Startups, Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, Korean Intellectual Property Office" shall be replaced by "Ministry of Finance and Economy, Ministry of Science and ICT, Ministry of Education, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, Ministry of Trade and Industry, Ministry of Health and Welfare, Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment, Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, Ministry of SMEs and Startups, Ministry of Planning and Budget, Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, Ministry of Intellectual Property".
(104) through (626) Omitted.

Article 8 Omitted.
